_comment: Per-place specials registry — keyed by DIRECTORY PLACE SLUG (same derivation as sync-directory.js slugify / app.js slugifyPlace: lowercase, punctuation→space, collapse spaces, drop leading 'the', spaces→hyphens — so "Jack's Family Tavern & Restaurant" would derive jack-s-family-tavern-restaurant — Jack's key stays jack-s-family-tavern via the sheet row's explicit slug cell). A key that doesn't equal its directory row's slug silently detaches: after any edit, load the Map page and check the browser console for 'specials-match: unmatched slugs'. Hand-maintained fields: name, note, audience ('locals' hides from marauders / 'marauders' hides from townies — omit for everyone), closedDays, season, daily, recurring, events. The Cowork specials task maintains each place's weekly block — dateRange + EXCLUSIVE validThrough (the day AFTER the last valid day) + items, en-dash prices, '(Fri only)'-style day tags that age out once that day has passed. The Corn Wagon's weekly items are NOT stored here — scrape.js scrapes thecornwagon.com/current-info live each run (this entry's presence is the on/off switch; season gates it). VFW Post 7294 and John Herr's are NOT in this file — they keep their dedicated pipelines (vfw.json / grocery.json) and are assembled in scrape.js under literal slug keys.
_format: places.<slug> = { name, note?, audience? ('locals'|'marauders'), closedDays? ['Sunday',...], season? {fromMonth,toMonth}, activeRanges? [{from,to} ISO dates, INCLUSIVE both ends — calendar windows during which the entry's STANDING content is live: gates the daily/recurring/weekly passthrough AND each recurringEvents instance's date; dated events[] stay exempt (they carry their own calendar); a written gate with no valid ranges fails CLOSED], daily? {Day:[items]}, recurring? {Day:'item'}, weekly? {dateRange, validThrough, items[]}, events? [{title, date (ISO w/ ET offset), endTime?, description?, price?, link?, kidFriendly?}], eventTag? (source tag for ALL this place's emitted events — default Community; a non-Community tag is a real source and needs Hard-Rule-7 wiring: app.js + eventMatch.js + events.ics.php, like Jack's Tavern → jacks-tavern-all), recurringEvents? [{title, day (weekday name), time (HH:MM 24h ET), description?, link?, price?, kidFriendly?, benefits? (['Free Food',…] — perk badges + the Marauder free-food filter), perkFoodIcon? (glyph replacing 🍕 on that event's Free Food badge, e.g. 🌭), expandCount?/expandDays? (widen the default next-3-within-28-days expansion — set high, e.g. 60/365, to list EVERY in-window instance for the year; activeRanges still clips each instance)}] — standing weekly items scrape.js expands into the next 3 dated instances each run. events are emitted located at the place name. Items containing 🍺 are ALCOHOL-FLAGGED: hidden site-wide (rail, card boxes, Today lens, pins) for every viewer unless they enable the 'Show 21+ drink specials' checkbox in My Favorites — applies to daily, recurring, and task-written weekly items alike.
